translationRepairs: Prince Xian of Huaiyang, Qin, was established in the third year of Yuankang (65 BCE). His mother, Lady Zhang the Honored Lady, enjoyed Emperor Xuan’s favor.
Prince Xian of Huaiyang, Qin, was established in the third year of Yuankang (63 BCE). His mother, Lady Zhang the Honored Lady, enjoyed Emperor Xuan’s favor.

元康三年 is Yuankang year 3; the era began in 65 BCE, so year 3 is 63 BCE. The parenthetical (65 BCE) wrongly equates year 3 with year 1; the proposed (63 BCE) is correct and otherwise leaves the accurate wording unchanged.
